page.overview:
What is Sky Island?

Urouge's homeland is a sky island, although the name of the island has not yet been stated.

Non-canonically, Waford was an artificial sky island, though it has since fallen into the Blue Sea.

The existence of sky islands is largely mocked or ignored by many. To those living in the Blue Sea, the idea of an island in the sky seems illogical, impossible, or unbelievable.

Traveling to a sky island is difficult due to their location, although not entirely impossible. There are two known ways to reach a sky island: to ride a current known as the Knock Up Stream, or through something called the , though details of the summit are unknown.
